justification: Serum sodium of 140.96 mmol/L is at the upper limit of normal (normal range 135-145 mmol/L) but the value itself is physiologically plausible; however, LOINC code 2947-0 is for sodium in serum/plasma, and this specific value represents mild hypernatremia which is survivable but clinically significant and should be flagged as borderline implausible without clinical context suggesting acute dehydration or other explanatory conditions.
